stage0073_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$せわし$$
「Those days of fighting tied to Bardos Island...」

stage0073_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$のっそり$$
「And it all ends today, right here.」

stage0073_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$もりもり$$
「Juzo-chan...
　Watch over $$甲児$$ and the others' fight from beyond.」

stage0073_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$弓$$
（What worries me is the whereabouts of
　the $$くろがね屋$$'s proprietress... Where could she be...）

stage0073_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$竜馬$$
「You've got plenty of fight in you, $$甲児$$.」

stage0073_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$甲児$$
「Yes.
　I have no more doubts.」

stage0073_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$スズネ$$
「But it looks like $$さやか$$ hasn't slept well.」

stage0073_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Just kidding.
　I just wanted to tease her a little.」

stage0073_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Is that jealousy, Miss $$スズネ$$?」

stage0073_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$スズネ$$
「The three sisters who keep single women company.」

stage0073_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Relax, $n.
　It was just a joke to ease the tension.」

stage0073_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ボス$$
「You're getting the cold shoulder, Miss $$スズネ$$...」

stage0073_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$スズネ$$
「And I really put myself on the line for that bit...」

stage0073_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$甲児$$
「Thank you, Miss $$スズネ$$.
　Thanks to you, I could relax.」

stage0073_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$アルト$$
「Now I can give it everything I've got.」

stage0073_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$宗介$$
「I see...
　So this kind of support counts as volunteer work too.」

stage0073_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$カレン$$
「Don't say things you don't need to...!」

stage0073_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ミサト$$
「I was worried everyone might be too tense,
　given this is the decisive battle, but
　it looks like there's no problem.」

stage0073_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Our opponent is $$あしゅら男爵$$, and he's on
　his last legs. Fight as you always do,
　and you'll surely win.」

stage0073_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「But there's nothing to do but accept the challenge.」

stage0073_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$田中司令$$
「The Mechanical Beast Legion has arrived.」

stage0073_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「$$兜甲児$$...! And $c!
　Let me thank you for granting my final wish!」

stage0073_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「But this $$あしゅら$$... will not die for nothing!
　I'll take as many of you to hell with me as I can!」

stage0073_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$赤木$$
「Let me tell you, our fight isn't over yet!」

stage0073_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$桂$$
「Sorry, but take that trip to hell together,
　just the two of you, nice and cozy.」

stage0073_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Fufufu... Even that sharp tongue of yours,
　now, makes it sad to part with.」

stage0073_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Now come, $c!
　Paint this $$あしゅら男爵$$'s final march to death
　with your blood!!」

stage0073_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「$$兜甲児$$!
　Now is the time for our reckoning!」

stage0073_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$甲児$$
「Here I come!
　The fate bound to Bardos Island... and the fate
　between you and me, I'll end it all right here!!」

stage0073_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$あしゅら$$
（Let the sight of you fighting sear itself
　into this $$あしゅら$$'s eyes, mind, and soul.）

stage0073_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$あしゅら$$
（That will light the fire of my obsession
　and turn it into strength...!）

stage0073_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「So it comes to this, after all...」

stage0073_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Fufufu... Just as I thought.」

stage0073_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「A reward for staying with me to the end.
　I'll break the Prison of Time, just for a moment.」

stage0073_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Yes... The time that stopped moves again.」

stage0073_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「My thanks, $$兜甲児$$.
　Thanks to you all, Mycenae's Tristan and Isolde
　can fulfill their true purpose!」

stage0073_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Let me tell you one last thing!
　Dr. Hell's true enemy was never you all!」

stage0073_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$甲児$$
「What are you talking about, $$あしゅら$$!」

stage0073_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Someday, he wanted photon power
　so he could fight us Mycenaeans...!」

stage0073_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「That's right!
　The only thing that can resist us is $$ゼウス$$'s light!」

stage0073_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「His Hell King $$ゴードン$$ was to seize photon power
　and become the strength to fight Mycenae!」

stage0073_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Mycenae has already fallen!
　What he's saying doesn't add up!」

stage0073_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Thousands of years ago, the gods of Mycenae
　fell asleep, awaiting the day battle would come.」

stage0073_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「And they entrusted that awakening
　to their chosen vessels, Tristan and Isolde.」

stage0073_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$つばさ$$
「Someone!
　Anyone will do!
　Please, stop $$あしゅら$$!!」

stage0073_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Dr. Hell didn't bind my mind
　only to seize Mycenae's civilization.」

stage0073_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「No... if anything, that was trivial.
　He feared I would fulfill my role.」

stage0073_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「$$兜甲児$$! You all defeated Dr. Hell
　and undid the seal on my memories!」

stage0073_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「My thanks, $$兜甲児$$! And $$錦織つばさ$$!
　Now that the ill star fills the heavens,
　everything needed for the ritual is ready!!」

stage0073_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Now, we offer up our lives!!
　Rise again, gods of Mycenaeeee!!」

stage0073_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$竜馬$$
「That guy...!
　He gave his own life!!」

stage0073_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$アムロ$$
「What is this ritual!?
　What in the world is happening!?」

stage0073_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$赤木$$
「Could it be the Prison of Time is breaking!?」

stage0073_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$桂$$
「However you look at it, this sure doesn't
　feel like it's heading for a happy ending!」

stage0073_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$安$$
「My years of instinct are acting up...」

stage0073_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$お菊$$
「Guess I won't be living much longer than this...」

stage0073_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, brace for impact!
　Something's happening!!」

stage0073_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ボス$$
「W-what are those things!?
　Are they Mechanical Beasts!?」

stage0073_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$さやか$$
「That's... what $$あしゅら$$ was talking about...」

stage0073_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$甲児$$
「Are those the gods of Mycenae!?」

stage0073_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Oh...? So there's one who knows of us.」

stage0073_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$タケル$$
「So they're different from Mechanical Beasts!」

stage0073_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「A lowly human daring to judge
　us, the gods of Olympus?」

stage0073_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「However many thousand years pass,
　humanity remains foolish!!」

stage0073_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$のっそり$$
「Power on a whole different scale!
　And such energy!!」

stage0073_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$せわし$$
「T-that's truly a power beyond human understanding!」

stage0073_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Lord $$ハーデス$$ is enraged!」

stage0073_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「To calm the wrath of Lord $$ハーデス$$,
　one of the Three Great Gods...!」

stage0073_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「There's no choice but to slaughter
　every human before us!」

stage0073_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$甲児$$
「I don't know where you crawled out of,
　but quit running your mouth!」

stage0073_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「No mistake!
　He is... He's the one!」

stage0073_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$甲児$$
「I remember now!
　That black giant... In the illusion Kedora
　showed me, he fought the golden god!」

stage0073_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Guhehe... It seems this isn't mere chance.
　The power entrusted to him must have drawn
　our wrath, awakening us at last.」

stage0073_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Gods of Olympus.
　Now that you've awoken, I shall withdraw
　my hand from Earth.」

stage0073_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Vega's already finished.
　$$イズモ$$... I'm sorry, but this isn't the
　time to chase after a $$レア・イグラー$$ anymore」

stage0073_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$シン$$
「Are they giving up on Earth...?」

stage0073_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Is it out of fear of those things called gods...!?」

stage0073_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Watch out...!
　Those guys mean business!」

stage0073_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「What meaning could that possibly have?」

stage0073_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「We are gods.
　Do not think mere humans can win
　just because you've built giants of steel!」

stage0073_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「It's just as you think.
　Those things are one of the 'gods.'」

stage0073_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Gods of Olympus!
　After our long slumber,
　we have awoken upon this land!!」

stage0073_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「This planet belongs to us!
　Teach the feeble humans who thrived
　in our slumber to whom it belongs!」

stage0073_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Spare these fools two minutes!
　Show the humans the power of gods!」

stage0073_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$甲児$$
「So, you're called $$ハーデス$$!
　I'll show you the power of the humans
　you called feeble!」

stage0073_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$甲児$$
「Gods or not, we won't lose!
　Not when we're protecting people!!」

stage0073_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Not bad!
　It seems humans have grown a bit stronger!」

stage0073_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$スザク$$
「No good...!
　The power gap is too great!」

stage0073_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If we keep fighting like this...」

stage0073_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$甲児$$
「But I have no choice but to do it!!」

stage0073_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「That light...!
　I see, now everything connects!」

stage0073_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$甲児$$
「Here I come, $$ハーデス$$!!
　Even if it costs me my life,
　I'll take you down with me!!」

stage0073_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Fool!
　You think I'd fall behind mere humans twice!!」

stage0073_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$つばさ$$
「Even Mazinger's power...
　doesn't work against him... against $$ハーデス$$...」

stage0073_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$アマタ$$
「That $$ハーデス$$ guy's power...!
　It's on a whole different level!!」

stage0073_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$甲児$$
「Not yet...!
　$$マジンガーＺ$$ hasn't lost yet!!」

stage0073_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Still struggling, are you!
　That's no fun otherwise!!」

stage0073_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$マジンガーＺ$$!
　Give it everything you've got left!!」

stage0073_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Guhahaha, how pathetic!
　Can you no longer even see your own enemy!?」

stage0073_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Not good!
　He's about to lose consciousness!!」

stage0073_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$ミサト$$
「A $$時空震動$$, at a time like this!?」

stage0073_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Nguuh!
　You were meant to have vanished into
　the dimensional rift... why are you here!?」

stage0073_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「A warrior who inherited my soul
　awakened me from my slumber in the dark」

stage0073_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Guhahaha, how amusing!
　Is this too because the war of gods
　and devils reaches even this dimension!?」

stage0073_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Wait, $$ハーデス$$!
　I'll settle this once and for all!」

stage0073_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Guhuhu... I can feel your impatience, $$ゼウス$$.
　Just as I thought - that arm of yours
　is a borrowed one, isn't it?」

stage0073_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「That's not all.
　That body of yours... I see it too
　is nothing but a temporary form」

stage0073_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Farewell, $$ゼウス$$!
　Go back to the dimensional rift, and watch
　as $$バアル$$ destroys the humans you love!」

stage0073_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$隼人$$
「Wait!
　What is this war of gods and devils!?」

stage0073_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$隼人$$
「If you're really gods,
　shouldn't you be fighting devils... fighting
　$$バアル$$ alongside humanity!?」

stage0073_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Don't make me laugh, human!
　Lowly creatures like you, fighting alongside
　us who have ascended to godhood!?」

stage0073_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Before the war between gods and devils,
　we the higher beings, you humans
　mean absolutely nothing!」

stage0073_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Whether you live or die,
　it is of no concern to us, the gods!」

stage0073_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$キラ$$
「We're... humanity's existence means
　nothing in the fight against $$バアル$$...」

stage0073_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「That's nonsense!
　I've... we've fought space monsters!」

stage0073_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Don't get cocky over striking down a piece
　of $$バアル$$! When the 12,000-year wheel
　of rebirth closes, the unfit for godhood perish!」

stage0073_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「I'll teach you once again!
　Before the war of gods and devils,
　humanity's existence means nothing at all!!」

stage0073_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ミサト$$
「We should say they let us withdraw...」

stage0073_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「...as much as it galls me, $$ハーデス$$ is right...」

stage0073_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$タケル$$
「This helplessness... it's the same as when
　I was shown the power of the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$...」

stage0073_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Something's wrong here!
　Aren't gods supposed to be on humanity's side!!」

stage0073_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Next to their overwhelming power,
　our own strength is next to nothing...」

stage0073_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Same as how humans give no thought to insects...」

stage0073_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「My name is $$ゼウス$$.
　Like $$ハーデス$$ and the others, I too am
　called a god of Olympus」

stage0073_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「And I'm one who was saved by the
　warrior of steel sleeping there」

stage0073_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$赤木$$
「$$マジンガーＺ$$ saved a god...!?」

stage0073_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「That's right.
　That is why I left this right arm behind,
　so that he might inherit my soul」

stage0073_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$弁慶$$
「W-wait a moment!
　I don't really understand what you mean!」

stage0073_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Forgive me...
　The time I can remain in this dimension
　is already running out」

stage0073_04:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「When he wakes, tell him this:
　where there is hope, light is born」

stage0073_04:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$シモン$$
「It's no use, $$ノリコ$$...
　he's already gone」

stage0073_04:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$n
「Where there is hope, light is born... huh...」

stage0073_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Where the hell would we find
　something like that right now...」

stage0073_04:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$甲児$$
「How about that, $$あしゅら$$!
　I've beaten your last Mechanical Beast too!」

stage0073_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$あしゅら$$
（But your defeat will not be in vain.
　Someday, a soul will dwell in your remains）

stage0073_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$甲児$$
（$$ガラダＫ７$$ and $$ダブラスＭ２$$...
　the first Mechanical Beasts I ever fought...）

stage0073_04:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$甲児$$
（To think the last Mechanical Beasts
　I'd face would be these very two...!）

stage0073_04:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Here we go, last Mechanical Beasts!
　I'll beat you and put a complete end
　to the Mechanical Beast army!」

stage0073_04:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$甲児$$
「Even if my enemy calls itself a god,
　if it threatens peace, $$マジンガーＺ$$ and I
　will fight it!」

stage0073_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$甲児$$
「Here I come, Mycenae!
　I'll show you the power of humans
　you called feeble!!」

stage0073_04:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Tch!
　Calling yourselves gods, you're clearly
　no ordinary opponents!」

stage0073_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$竜馬$$
「But hey!
　$$流竜馬$$ ain't fallen so low
　he'd run from a fight halfway through!!」

stage0073_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ゼロ$$
（Those things are gods too...!
　Beings who've reached some higher stage!）

stage0073_04:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ゼロ$$
（Are these the final form of what that
　man, Charles zi Britannia, sought to become!）

stage0073_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$キリコ$$
（Are they... the same as Wiseman...?）

stage0073_04:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$アマタ$$
（Gods...
　What the hell even are gods...!?）

stage0073_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$アマタ$$
（Why does the back of my head throb
　whenever I look at them...!）

stage0073_04:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$シモン$$
「These things are just like the
　$$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$! Let's go all out, $$ヴィラル$$!」

stage0073_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$ズール$$... the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$...
　These Mycenaean gods rival their power...!」

stage0073_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$タケル$$
「Can humanity even win...!?
　Against this most vicious of enemies!」

stage0073_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$n
「These things... they're the same...!
　As $$ガドライト$$... and the angel I was chasing!」

stage0073_04:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$n
「These things think human lives are no
　better than garbage! I won't let scum
　like that have their way!」

stage0073_04:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$ロジャー$$
（Deep in my memory sleeps the existence
　of a transcendent being...）

stage0073_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
（Seeing these gods of Mycenae, I have to
　admit... that they truly are what's called gods...!）

stage0073_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$シンジ$$
「T-these things... they're nothing
　like the enemies we've faced before!」

stage0073_04:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Even $$ボン太くん#pilot$$'s saying this is bad news!」
